scenario: LDIA.9.2 — positive: `default` sets `call`, `nocooldown`, `cache` and `cache_delete` true, so a rule using all four compiles. (`record_event` is retired, [LGRA.10.1.5], so no rule can use it.) The `use default` line is written out so the pin does not rest on the harness supplying it.
rules_ds:
use default

service svc.method:
    """stub"""
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.method nocooldown
    cache key: "k" value: t.v
    cache_delete key: "old"
